description.fun: Skorupi is a scorpion put together back to front: its claws are on its tail and its stingers on its arms. It buries itself in sand and waits for prey, then grips it with its tail claws until the poison takes hold. It can go a whole year without eating, yet it struggles in the cold.
description.guide: Skorupi is a Poison- and Bug-type scorpion Pokémon of arid lands. It buries itself in sand to ambush prey, gripping it with the poisonous claws on its tail, and can go a year without eating. It evolves into Drapion.
description.tagline: A desert scorpion with claws where its stinger should be.

description.fun: People call Drapion the 'Sand Demon'. Its claws can tear a car to scrap, swords bounce off its armour, and its head swivels 180 degrees to watch every direction. It's so proud of its strength that it often doesn't bother using its poison. It's also the only Pokémon that isn't Bug type yet evolves from one, having traded Bug for Dark.
description.guide: Drapion is the evolved form of Skorupi, a Poison- and Dark-type scorpion Pokémon. It has a sturdy shell, can rotate its head 180 degrees, and its powerful claws carry poison. It is aggressive and attacks anything that enters its territory.
description.tagline: The desert's Sand Demon, with car-crushing claws.
